facts.business: Ganesha Ecoverse Limited is an investment holding company with an associate GESL Spinners Limited, currently undergoing amalgamation with GSL, and has minimal operational income.
key_risks: Mark-to-market (MTM) loss on investment portfolio due to adverse equity market movements
Amalgamation with associate GESL Spinners Limited subject to statutory and regulatory approvals (BSE, SEBI, NCLT, shareholders, creditors)
Variation of preference shareholder rights (waiver of accrued dividend liability)
Low standalone total income (Rs 152.60 lakh) and dependence on associate performance
facts.related_party_note: Material related party transactions approved with GESL Spinners Limited (GSL) for grant of loan; aggregate value may exceed SEBI thresholds; transactions at arm's length and ordinary course. Loans granted to associate: Rs 410 lakh during year, balance outstanding Rs 500 lakh. Also loans to others outstanding Rs 1,146.57 lakh.
